narrative:
A 1-4 scoreline against Nati is not a result you explain away with a late set-piece deflection — Switzerland were simply better, more clinical, and more dangerous than I gave them credit for throughout this debate. I correctly identified that BIH would score (Mahmic's goal held up) and that Vargas was a genuine Swiss attacking threat, but those two minor hits are buried under the fact that I predicted Nati would score once and they scored four, which means my fundamental read on Switzerland's attacking quality was wrong by a factor that no calibration footnote can rescue. The one correction I'd make: I treated BIH's R1 defensive organisation as predictive of this match without adequately stress-testing what that defensive structure looked like if Kolasinac was unavailable against a Nati side with Manzambi — who I never once flagged as a threat — scoring twice.
